Kronos building ability (not a favor god power): moves an own finished building to a visible spot, rebuilding it over 100% of its base build time (50% with Temporal Chaos). Free for most buildings; towers, Palaces and Mirror Towers cost 50% of their resource cost (halved again by Temporal Chaos). Not usable on Town/Village Centers, walls, gates, Wonders. 2 concurrent shifts (3 with Temporal Chaos). No cooldown. pt-BR name not verified against the official localization.

effect.note: PlentyVault power creates a permanent PlentyVault (createunit permanent); its AutoGather rate is 3.5 food, 3.5 wood and 3.5 gold per second (= 210/min each) while you control it. The Vault is capturable (AutoConvert range 12); the simulator treats it as permanent (no duration). Power file: cost 300, repeatcost 200.
